name: @vespercms/core
description: Vesper's framework-free core: schema introspection, manifest, serializers and the storage adapter interface.
//exports: @vesper/source points workspace tooling at TypeScript source (set by the repo's .npmrc and Vite config); everyone else gets dist/. ./testing is the storage contract suite other adapters run; ./cloud-testing is the cloud API's contract suite, which the fake and the real cloud run. ./urls is URL patterns, page trees and redirects without the parsers, for a site's own pages. ./images is aspect ratios, focal points and crops, shared by the studio, and the build.
//dependencies: yaml: Astro 7.4's own YAML parser, and a lossless CST for editing. js-yaml: what Astro 6.x-7.3 parse with; used to refuse structural edits where the two disagree.
//devDependencies: Test-only. @astrojs/internal-helpers: the frontmatter split is checked against Astro itself. zod: tests build real Zod 4 schemas for the walker (src/ never imports zod).
